reserveReview.rationale: The November 18, 2026 Chronicle source payload (CID QmPQnDVp37aJZzTt6UCaK9UAdQv2EUseEiaxjYmfmULvBf, followed from the configured Chronicle STAC proof page, re-verified 2026-11-20 by CID fetches from Chronicle and gateway.pinata.cloud returning byte-identical payloads with sha256 96121a4b71008bccf05c24e79be4fbc700335fd36555b5456997fa7c204e2bd4) directly identifies STAC fund NAV of $285,810,523.10 and 51 named CLO positions with aggregate portfolio market value $280,999,622.24, plus cash of $3,215,085.19 and other net assets/liabilities of $1,595,815.62. Against the September 29 payload (CID Qmedv33sWmMtXbho9dbZaXuFgsw7nL2c82UU6Rpt2aDY1J, 49 positions, $277,571,572.67, retained as a prior reference) all 49 original ISINs remain with unchanged units and maturity dates. Against the pinned October 19 census (CID QmWrPqxJEXQf9EtFhzAU22VUDwbzszffx9KAZhgvwYx6Eq, 50 positions, $278,601,185.26) the only roster change is the addition of AGL CORE CLO 5.31444% 07/20/2039 (US001200AQ71); the 50 shared ISINs keep unchanged units and maturity dates, with market values and coupon figures re-marked, and ARINI US CLO V 5.27249% 04/15/2039 (US04040CAA53) was already present in that census. The observed maximum position maturity is unchanged at 2041-07-17; it is an observation, not a legal maximum or WAM/WAL claim. The static reserve row remains the single 100% fund-NAV identity emitted by the live chronicle-nav adapter; its high-risk public-credit classification describes the identified fund claim, not a claim that every underlying asset is a CLO tranche. No PGIM AAA CLO ETF appears in this dated portfolio. Chronicle technically verifies third-party source data and expressly disclaims underlying-data attestation or audit. The older July position census and its maturity maximum are not carried forward.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Chronicle November 18, 2026 dated fund-NAV proof and position census; single fund-share scoring bucket matching the live chronicle-nav adapter
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The full reserve row identifies the STAC fund-NAV claim, so no reserve row is unidentified. Underlying cash counterparties, other net assets/liabilities, and fund legal terms are not disclosed by this proof; no gross unknown-exposure percentage is inferred from net balances. The 51 named CLO positions have individual maturities, but those dates do not establish a contractual maturity maximum for the fund share.
